verdict.rationale: Codex is explicitly a delegated coding agent that runs tasks autonomously in cloud sandboxes or locally via CLI/IDE, taking tasks from GitHub, Slack, Linear, etc., and returning diffs/PRs for review — a clear built-in AI assistant/agent delegation model. Community evidence confirms real-world use as a delegated agent (favorable comparisons to 'having L3-L4 engs'), though with caveats around speed, reliability, and rate limits.
